title: BUG-FUNC-033: the ERF/ERFC family rejects a logical operand, checked against Excel
upstream_status_verbatim: - **Ref notes**: live Excel COM, Excel `16.0` build `20026`, exact typed equality.
status_plain: All four ERF/ERFC surfaces coerced a logical operand to a number and computed, where Excel returns #VALUE!. The Excel differential re-check confirms all four now return a value error and match Excel, while ERF still accepts numeric text and the sibling GAMMA/GAMMALN family still accepts logicals -- so the rejection is scoped to ERF/ERFC and is not a property of the shared unary special-dist path. This is a live-Excel COM structural comparison at build 20026 under exact typed equality, on the structural-admission axis. It never reached a counted verification record, which is why all four surfaces would otherwise render as having no structural comparison at all.

counts.figure: all four ERF/ERFC `arg0_logical` probes now `error:Value` (match Excel)
counts.build_note: "live Excel COM, Excel `16.0` build `20026`, exact typed equality" is stated in the stream's Ref notes at line 14.
counts.corpus_or_build: Excel differential `erf-logical-recheck-001`, the four arg0_logical probes
counts.ambiguity_note: "All four probes" is a phrase, not a published fraction. No numerator or denominator is extracted here: the weaker reading is that a structural comparison is on record with no count. The corpus is also the repair's own validation set.
counts.source_sentence: - Excel differential `erf-logical-recheck-001`: all four ERF/ERFC `arg0_logical` probes now `error:Value` (match Excel); ERF `arg0_text_number` still matches (text accepted); GAMMALN.PRECISE still accepts logical.

substrate: a `reject_logical` flag on the shared `eval_unary_prepared`, set true for ERF/ERF.PRECISE/ERFC/ERFC.PRECISE and false for GAMMA/GAMMALN/GAMMALN.PRECISE
ruled_out: scoping the logical rejection to the shared unary special-dist path: the GAMMA/GAMMALN family accepts logicals, so the rejection is ERF/ERFC-specific
open_question: A remaining ERFC `arg0_text_number` 2-ULP drift and a GAMMALN.PRECISE(TRUE) near-zero drift are separate numeric-drift findings, not coercion.
reader_warning: This is admission behaviour -- which operand types Excel accepts and what error it publishes -- not numeric agreement. It says nothing about the bits of any ERF or ERFC result.
